Orchard Court

A courtyard house for three generations, set among the old apple trees of a former orchard.

Location
Westmere
Status
On site, due 2027
Type
New home
Area
4,200 sq ft
Team
Studio Verran with Larch Structural

The project

Materials

  • Rammed earth walls
  • Douglas fir structure
  • Clay tile roof
  • Cork insulation
  • Reused orchard timber

Each generation has its own wing around a shared courtyard, with a kitchen at the hinge where everyone meets.

The plan keeps eleven of the original apple trees. Foundations are pad-and-beam where they pass near roots.

Construction began in spring 2026; completion is planned for summer 2027.
